description: This file defines the CanvasController class, which manages a WebView for rendering and capturing canvases within an Android application. It includes functions for navigation, snapshotting in different formats, debugging, and controlling the WebView's state.

classes.name: CanvasController
classes.description: Main class responsible for controlling a WebView that renders a canvas, including snapshot capabilities, URL navigation, debug controls, and state management.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Associates a WebView instance with this controller and initializes state.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the specified WebView instance if it is currently attached.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Navigates the WebView to the specified URL or loads the scaffold if null or blank.

methods.name: currentUrl
methods.description: Returns the current URL loaded or null if none.

methods.name: isDefaultCanvas
methods.description: Checks if the current URL is the default scaffold.

methods.name: setDebugStatusEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables debug status display.

methods.name: setDebugStatus
methods.description: Sets the debug status title and subtitle.

methods.name: onPageFinished
methods.description: Triggers after a page load to update debug and home canvas state.

methods.name: updateHomeCanvasState
methods.description: Updates the JSON state for the home canvas rendering.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates JavaScript code within the WebView and returns the result.

methods.name: snapshotPngBase64
methods.description: Captures a screenshot of the WebView as a PNG encoded Base64 string, with optional max width.

methods.name: snapshotBase64
methods.description: Captures a screenshot in specified format (PNG/JPEG) with optional quality and max width.
